function.name: check_tech_availability
function.description: Return open 2-hour technician arrival windows for supported appliances (refrigeration, dishwasher, laundry, cooking, Bosch, Miele, Gaggenau, Sub-Zero). Do NOT call for unsupported services like pool heaters or water heaters. Zone is OPTIONAL — omit it to search all service areas.

zone.description: Optional service zone. Omit entirely to search all service areas.

skill.description: Canonical skill: refrigeration, dishwasher, laundry, cooking, bosch, miele, gaggenau, sub-zero.

appliance_type.description: Appliance type/category requested by caller (e.g. dishwasher, refrigerator).

preferred_date.description: Optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD or datetime.

function.name: lookup_job
function.description: Look up an appointment / job ID when the caller does not know their job ID. Call this with the caller's confirmed account phone number (e.g. +15550108800) to find their job ID, appliance, and scheduled arrival window.

phone.description: Account phone number (e.g. +15550108800 or spoken digits). Used to locate active jobs.

customer_name.description: Optional caller name on the account to assist lookup.

job_id.description: Optional job ID if verifying a specific appointment.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book a technician for an open arrival window for supported appliances. Requires tech_id + window_start from open_windows. Writes a Scheduled job into the CRM cache.

technician.description: Technician display name if tech_id is missing.

window_start.description: arrival_window_start ISO from open_windows (must match an open slot).

phone.description: Caller phone number for the booking record.

model_serial.description: Appliance model or serial number if provided.

function.name: reschedule_parts_install
function.description: Reschedule a parts installation after validating parts status in the CRM. Keeps the primary technician from the diagnostic visit when parts are in stock.

preferred_date.description: Desired install date or datetime in ISO-8601.

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description: Cancel an appointment with verified caller ownership. Accepts job_id and/or account phone number. Enforces 24h fee ($85) — if fee_applicable and not yet confirmed, read speak_this, get verbal confirmation, then call again with confirmed=true.

job_id.description: Job id (digits ok, e.g. 1088). Optional if account phone number is provided to locate active job.

phone.description: Account phone number for caller verification. Required to verify ownership.

customer_name.description: Optional caller name to assist lookup.

confirmed.description: True only after caller verbally accepts the fee when fee_applicable was returned.

function.name: transfer_to_dispatcher
function.description: Transfer the caller to a human dispatcher when verification fails repeatedly, for unsupported appliance escalations, or upon direct caller request.

reason.description: Reason for escalating to human dispatcher (e.g. verification failure, complex inquiry).
